commentary.title: Bank Indonesia Macro Commentary & Fixed Income Outlook
commentary.executiveSummary: Bank Indonesia maintains its stability-oriented monetary stance with the BI-Rate at 5.75% (Headline CPI at 3.28% YoY), supported by official JISDOR fixing at Rp 18,094 (5 November 2026) and spot USD/IDR at 18,075. 12M SRBI auctions cleared at a 6.601% weighted average accepted rate on IDR 41.81 T nominal bids, while 5Y IndoGB trades at 7.66% and 10Y FR0100 yields 7.74% (+290 bps over 10Y UST).

macroPillars.heading: Monetary & Liquidity Operations (SRBI Weighted Average Rates)
macroPillars.analysis: Bank Indonesia continues pro-market open market operations via SRBI auctions with the policy BI-Rate at 5.75%. As published on Bank Indonesia Operasi Moneter and CEIC Data, latest weighted average accepted rates cleared at 6.491% for 6M, 6.530% for 9M, and 6.601% for 12M (IDR 41.81 T nominal bids), preserving an orderly carry buffer above US front-end rates.

macroPillars.heading: Sovereign Debt Curve (IndoGB Benchmark Yields)
macroPillars.analysis: IndoGB yields reflect active secondary market repricing and institutional demand. The 5Y benchmark (FR0101) trades at 7.66% while the 10Y benchmark (FR0100) trades at 7.74%, establishing a +290 bps sovereign spread over 10Y US Treasuries.

macroPillars.heading: Currency Dynamics (JISDOR Rp 18,094 & Offshore NDF)
macroPillars.analysis: Bank Indonesia's official JISDOR reference rate fixed at Rp 18,094 per USD on 5 November 2026 (following Rp 18,140 on 4 November 2026). Offshore 1-Month NDFs trade at 18,111 (+36 IDR spread / 2.39% p.a. basis), while IDX Composite (IHSG) closed at 4,919.77 (+0.32%).

commentary.biPolicyPosture: Vigilant FX Stabilization (BI-Rate 5.75% · Headline CPI 3.28% YoY)
